article.title: Average Is Not the Same as Typical

paragraphs.en: People often use the average to describe a typical customer, salary, purchase, or waiting time. But the average, or mean, can be pulled strongly by a few extreme values. Imagine ten customers. Nine spend about $20, while one spends $500. The mean is much higher than what most customers actually spend. If we describe the “average customer” using that number, we may create a person who is not typical at all. The median can help. To find the median, put all values in order and look at the middle. Extreme values have much less influence on it. This is useful for skewed data such as income, wealth, transaction value, and response time. However, the median is not always better. The mean is important when totals matter. If a company wants to estimate total revenue from the number of customers, average revenue per customer has a direct financial meaning. Analysts should therefore choose a summary based on the question. They can also show both mean and median, together with percentiles or a simple distribution chart. If the mean is far above the median, that difference itself tells us something about the data. A clear report might say, “Mean annual spending is $1,200, but the median is $620 because a small group of high spenders raises the average.” That sentence is more informative than calling $1,200 typical. A summary statistic is a tool, not a complete description of the population. Before saying what a normal customer looks like, check the shape of the distribution. Analysts should define the population, time window, operational constraint, and decision objective before interpreting the metric. paragraphs.zh: 繁中完整翻譯與解說：本文從代表值、feature design、cohort、top-K evaluation 與 Goodhart’s Law 說明，分析必須配合資料分布、customer lifecycle、operational capacity 與真正的 business objective。不能因單一 metric 看起來漂亮，就忽略它如何被產生或被最佳化。
paragraphs.ja: 日本語完全訳・解説：代表値、feature design、cohort、top-K evaluation、Goodhart’s Lawを通じ、分析をdata distribution、customer lifecycle、operational capacity、真のbusiness objectiveと結び付ける必要性を説明する。単一metricだけで判断してはいけない。
